title: Read the optional download helper
description: You inspect the archive branch and its recorded fallback.

steps.description: You import archive and path tools, then try the Colab files import. Archive creation and download also sit inside the try block.
You create artifacts.zip and request its download when artifacts exists. The other branch prints a missing-folder message.

steps.question: Where does an exception from files.download go?
steps.answer: The except block prints the helper-unavailable message with its exception text.

steps.description: You see that handler's message in the recording. It reports google.colab.files.download unavailable in code-viz.
